title: Diverticulitis, home; summary transmission only planned ('will fax') and plan never documented as discussed with the patient

rationale.info_transmitted: The note only says the summary will be faxed; there is no evidence it was actually sent.
rationale.dp_discussed: No document shows the discharge plan was discussed with the patient or a representative; the only patient preference noted concerns surgery, not the discharge plan.
rationale.pac_list: Not referred to home health, SNF, IRF or LTCH, so the three post-acute rules do not apply.
rationale.meds_consistent: No nursing discharge instructions were provided, so there is nothing to compare.
